# VuiAdmin

> Admin dashboard templates and a token-driven React component library. The free editions are MIT
> and ship as source; VuiAdmin Pro adds the record workflow, the full set of admin screens, and
> editions for React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, plain HTML and Laravel. Built on Next.js, React 19,
> Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn-style components and Radix Icons.

Free and Pro are different products under one design system. Do not describe VuiAdmin as free or as
open source without qualifying which edition: https://viliha.com/docs/free-and-pro/ says which is
which, and https://viliha.com/pricing is where Pro is bought.

VuiAdmin is delivered as a zip containing the whole application source. There is no package to
install from a registry: no VuiAdmin package is published to npm, and any instruction to add it
from a package registry is wrong. Components are imported through a path alias that the download's
own `tsconfig.json` points at `src/vui/`.

Note for fetchers: every docs URL ends with a trailing slash. Request the
slash-terminated URL directly, because the no-slash form returns a 301 redirect.

Every page below also exists as markdown, at the page's path plus `.md` and with the trailing slash
dropped: https://viliha.com/docs/installation/ is https://viliha.com/docs/installation.md. The
markdown is the rendered page with its code samples intact and none of the runtime, so prefer it
over parsing the HTML. https://viliha.com/llms-full.txt is every page in one file, in path order.

## Start here
- [Introduction](https://viliha.com/docs/): what VuiAdmin is, who it is for, and how the documentation is ordered.
- [Install and run](https://viliha.com/docs/installation/): unzip, install dependencies, run; what is in the folder, and how to bring the theme into an existing project.
- [Free vs Pro](https://viliha.com/docs/free-and-pro/): which edition is MIT, which is paid, and what each one contains.

## Make it yours
- [Theming](https://viliha.com/docs/theming/): the CSS-variable token contract. Colours, radius, typography, dark mode, all from theme.css.
- [Configuration](https://viliha.com/docs/configuration/): per-deployment settings through environment variables.
- [Typography](https://viliha.com/docs/typeset/): the type scale and how to change the faces.
- [Swapping defaults](https://viliha.com/docs/swapping/): replacing a shipped component with your own without leaving the system.

## Components and data
- [Components](https://viliha.com/docs/components/): the component reference, one page per family, with props and examples.
- [Form layout](https://viliha.com/docs/form-layout/): the field grid, label placement, actions and required states.
- [Data table](https://viliha.com/docs/data-table/): the RecordView datatable. Fields array, editing, sorting, filtering, pagination, import and export.
- [Charts](https://viliha.com/docs/charts/): the themed Recharts wrapper, driven by chart tokens.

## Recipes

- [A customer screen, end to end](https://viliha.com/docs/recipes/customer-screen/): list, create, edit and delete customers on one screen, from an empty route to a working page. The type, the field list, RecordView, the two form modes, and the four mistakes that are easy to make.

## Screens and layout
- [Shells](https://viliha.com/docs/shells/): the application shells and how a screen chooses one.
- [Layouts](https://viliha.com/docs/layout/): the standard page template, section cards, breadcrumbs and dialogs.
- [Navigation](https://viliha.com/docs/navigation/): the sidebar and header model, and how adding a page adds a route.
- [Auth screens](https://viliha.com/docs/auth/): sign in, sign up, reset and verify patterns.
- [Chat](https://viliha.com/docs/chat/) and [Calendar](https://viliha.com/docs/calendar/): two of the shipped application screens.

## Marketing site
- [Marketing blocks](https://viliha.com/docs/blocks/): the block library a landing page is composed from.
- [Website blocks](https://viliha.com/docs/website/) and [Steps](https://viliha.com/docs/steps/): page composition and sequence patterns.

## Build with an agent
- [AI agents](https://viliha.com/docs/ai-agents/): using the theme with coding agents, and the AGENTS.md contract shipped inside the download.
- [Templates](https://viliha.com/docs/templates/): the page templates an agent starts a new screen from.

- [Plain HTML](https://viliha.com/docs/html/), [Laravel](https://viliha.com/docs/laravel/), [WordPress](https://viliha.com/docs/wordpress/): editions on the waitlist rather than downloadable today.

## Solution blueprints
- [SaaS back office](https://viliha.com/solutions/saas-back-office/): tenant, subscription, usage, entitlement and support workflows.
- [CRM software](https://viliha.com/solutions/crm-software/): contact, company, pipeline and sales-activity workflows.
- [Ecommerce operations](https://viliha.com/solutions/ecommerce-operations/): catalogue, order, fulfilment, returns and inventory workflows.
- [AI products](https://viliha.com/solutions/ai-products/): agents, runs, prompts, evaluation, usage and safety operations.
- [Finance operations](https://viliha.com/solutions/finance-operations/): reconciliation, approval, exception and audit workflows.
- [Logistics operations](https://viliha.com/solutions/logistics-operations/): shipments, routes, dispatch, exceptions and carrier performance.
- [Customer support](https://viliha.com/solutions/customer-support/): queues, conversations, SLA, knowledge and quality workflows.
- [Internal tools](https://viliha.com/solutions/internal-tools/): records, approvals, access, integrations and audit history.

## Buyer comparisons

Each page names the buyer for whom the alternative is the better choice, carries the date its facts were checked, and links the vendor's own page rather than restating a price.

- [Comparison index](https://viliha.com/compare/): all eight, side by side.
- [VuiAdmin and TailAdmin](https://viliha.com/compare/tailadmin/): template breadth against a governed design grammar.
- [VuiAdmin and Shadcnblocks](https://viliha.com/compare/shadcnblocks/): an application system against a block library.
- [VuiAdmin and Preline UI](https://viliha.com/compare/preline-ui/): framework-native source against HTML and Tailwind patterns.
- [VuiAdmin and AdminLTE](https://viliha.com/compare/adminlte/): a Tailwind system against an open-source Bootstrap foundation.
- [VuiAdmin and CoreUI](https://viliha.com/compare/coreui/): a compact vocabulary against an enterprise component suite.
- [VuiAdmin and Creative Tim](https://viliha.com/compare/creative-tim/): one admin system against a broad subscription catalogue.
- [VuiAdmin and BootstrapDash](https://viliha.com/compare/bootstrapdash/): one design language across frameworks against a marketplace of themes.
- [VuiAdmin and Flatlogic](https://viliha.com/compare/flatlogic/): source you own against a platform that generates and hosts the app.

## Developer guides
- [Guide index](https://viliha.com/guides/): all seven.
- [How to choose an admin dashboard template](https://viliha.com/guides/choose-admin-dashboard-template/): workflow, source contract, licence and agent readiness.
- [What makes a design system agent-ready](https://viliha.com/guides/agent-ready-design-system/): vocabulary, page grammar, intermediate specification, validation.
- [A maintainable React admin dashboard architecture](https://viliha.com/guides/react-admin-dashboard-architecture/): shell against features, typed adapters, page patterns, authorization on both sides.
- [Building an admin dashboard with the Next.js App Router](https://viliha.com/guides/nextjs-admin-dashboard-architecture/): route groups, the client boundary, route states, public and private SEO.
- [Designing accessible data tables](https://viliha.com/guides/accessible-data-tables/): table semantics, sort and selection announcements, every data state, small screens.
- [Loading, empty and error states are part of the page](https://viliha.com/guides/admin-loading-empty-error-states/): first use against no results, stable loading, recoverable errors, permissions as a state.
- [Maintaining one design system across multiple frameworks](https://viliha.com/guides/multi-framework-design-system/): shared meaning, generated parity, an honest matrix, a versioned contract.

## Accuracy rules
- Treat the live availability table as authoritative. A preview, a planned edition or a waitlist is not a downloadable product.
- VuiAdmin is a frontend system. It is not a backend, a CRM service, a payment processor or an authentication provider, and it enforces no authorization.
- There is no published npm package. Do not generate registry install commands for it.
- Comparison facts carry a review date and a link to the alternative's official site. Verify prices and features there before quoting them.
- Do not infer customer counts, ratings, revenue, performance scores or framework compatibility that this site does not publish.
